title: PSG4-C4096: larger discovery and a near-unit retry profile

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, put n=ceil(log2 N). The ONE PSG4-C4096 algorithm and exact parameter rule in proof.md recover the entire s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including failed attempts, rejected copies, retries, incorrect numerical-label branches and both cutoff aborts, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((365149/500000)sqrt(n log2 n))). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2 with the explicit finite branch covering smaller n. The exact envelope growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and clean-only tolerance declaration for the same configuration. The actual combiner uses k=b+6 children, verified-list cap 4096, at most 4096 blocks of 4096 search trials, and profile delta(v)=min{d>=0:20*2^d>=21*(2v+6)}. Its proved success 3963/4096>20/21 justifies the expected-attempt factor 21/20. All caps, parameters and precision are recomputed for this one configuration. The sharper feasible trial uses coefficient 730297/1000000 and the exact strict capacity certificate in proof.md.

For the same PSG4-C4096 algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
